hs: 2306.90 (oil-cake and other solid residues, other — incl. neem cake; also a DORB stream per DGFT Notification 37/2025-26)
source_name: WITS (World Bank) / UN Comtrade — India exports by partner, calendar year 2024
notes: MEDIUM CONFIDENCE ON PRODUCT ATTRIBUTION — figures are primary-tier (WITS/UN Comtrade) but 2306.90 is a residual 'other oilcake' basket covering neem cake, various minor oilcakes AND part of the de-oiled rice bran stream (DGFT Notification 37/2025-26 lists 2306 90 19 / 2306 90 29 / 2306 90 90 alongside 2302 40 00 for DORB). Do NOT attribute the USD 65.61M total to neem cake alone. Korea Rep. is an outlier worth noting: 175,417 MT for USD 16.83M implies a very low ~USD 96/MT unit value, consistent with bulk low-grade feed/fertilizer residue rather than a specialty product. Use directionally for market identification only.
